description: A project opencode.json that names the Ollama provider, sets the default model, and points at the word-tools MCP server.

steps.description: This is a project `opencode.json`. It sets the schema, one provider, and the default model. The page says to save it as `opencode.json` in your project.
`$schema` points at `https://opencode.ai/config.json`, so an editor knows which keys are legal.
The `provider` map holds `ollama`. `npm` is the adapter package, `name` is the display label, `options.baseURL` is `http://localhost:11434/v1`, and `models` lists `llama3.2` with `tools` set to true.
The `mcp` map defines the `word-tools` server. `type` is `local`, `command` runs `python3 word_count_server.py`, and `enabled` is true.

steps.question: The page says if `opencode mcp list` says no servers are configured, run it a second time, because the first listing in a new folder can come back what?

title: An OpenCode Config with a Local Model and an MCP Server
